description: rnews_main.rs:57-59 — The arg parser silently discards any unrecognised argument (wildcard arm just does i += 1). There is no --help or --version flag. A typo like 'stoa-rnews --conifg /etc/...' fails with 'error: --config <path> is required' rather than indicating the unknown flag. A new operator will have no way to discover valid flags without reading the source. Better approach: add --help output listing --config and --check with one-line descriptions; treat unrecognised flags as errors. A crate like clap (already used elsewhere in the workspace) would handle both at no extra maintenance cost.
title: unknown CLI args silently ignored, no --help
